Name: Link Attack
Overview: Staged in a classical puzzle style, link attack infuses an original puzzle concept with impactful imagery influenced by former Soviet Union communist propaganda. Original audio arranged and recorded in-house provides an invigorating background to the constant action. As a puzzle game, Link Attack contains 6 different game modes that task the player with unique and individual challenges. This constant excitement is further elaborated through interaction with the players Xbox avatar which is present and very much active throughout gameplay. A competitive two player mode finishes off the roster with a fast paced and invigorating mode and full high score tables round off the competitive spirit of the game.
